description: Joe Kent, the former U.S. counterterrorism director who resigned this week over concerns about the Iran war, said Wednesday during an appearance on Tucker Carlson's podcast that he and other senior officials "were not allowed" to share doubts about the U.S. airstrikes with President Donald Trump.
title: U.S. officials 'not allowed' to tell Trump Iran war concerns, former counterterrorism director claims

description: Labubu's toothy grin will be coming to the ‌big screen after toy-maker Pop Mart and Sony Pictures Entertainment announced plans to develop a feature film based on the viral ugly-cute monster.
title: Labubu is bound for the big screen, as Pop Mart aims to capitalize on toy's global success

description: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre is set to appear on The Joe Rogan Experience, one of the world's most popular podcasts.
title: Pierre Poilievre sits down for interview with podcaster Joe Rogan

description: For Leqaa Kordia, her newfound freedom means little to her until “everybody is free." “There is a lot of injustice in this place,” Kordia told reporters after emerging from a U.S. immigration detention centre in Texas on Monday. “There are a lot of people that shouldn’t be here in the first place. We’re going to keep fighting for them.”
title: Last detainee from Trump’s 2025 Gaza war protest crackdown freed after a year

description: Following extensive CBC News reporting on two Indian nationals deported for alleged links to the extortion crisis plaguing Canadian communities, the Canada Border Services Agency has identified the two men as proof of expanded efforts to disrupt extortion networks.
title: Border agency identifies accused extortionists following CBC News investigations

description: A recent temporary release of a child murderer in Durham Region is drawing criticism from top officials across Ontario, with calls for the parole board to keep him behind bars before he’s let out again.
title: Ont. premier, officials call for reversal of temporary release of convicted child killer

description: Five weeks after earning their first Olympic medal, Canadian ice dancers Piper Gilles and Paul Poirier are gearing up for their 13th world championships, next week in Prague. "We want to enjoy ourselves, enjoy our skating [and] celebrate what we've accomplished this season," Gilles says.
title: Canadian Olympic bronze-medal ice dancers Gilles, Poirier head to world championships

description: A Hamilton man who was on the run the past nine years was arrested in Mexico in connection with two mob-related killings and faces at least two murder counts. Daniel Tomassetti, 35, was arrested in August 2025, police told CBC Hamilton, and efforts “are underway to facilitate his extradition to Canada."
title: Ontario man accused in mob-related killings arrested in Mexico after 9 years on the run

description: Civil rights ​leader Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers union with Cesar Chavez and fought alongside him for decades to expand labour rights in the U.S., on Wednesday accused Chavez of sexually assaulting her in the 1960s.
title: U.S. civil rights leader Dolores Huerta says Cesar Chavez sexually assaulted her in the 1960s

description: A year after the actor's death, a generative AI version of Val Kilmer will co-star in an independent film, in one of the boldest uses yet of artificial intelligence in moviemaking.
title: An AI Val Kilmer is set to posthumously appear in a new movie

description: Pakistan has announced a pause in strikes against Afghanistan, saying the decision was made ahead of the Muslim holiday of Eid al-Fitr at the request of Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Turkey.
title: Pakistan pausing strikes against Afghanistan for end of Ramadan

description: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says she travelled on a private plane to Saudi Arabia last fall to meet with local government officials, following an invitation from a member of the Saudi royal family.
title: Alberta premier says she took private flight last year following invitation from Saudi government

description: Police say a teen in the town of Bridgewater, N.S., and a youth from Manitoba have been arrested for allegedly planning simultaneous attacks at their local schools.
title: Nova Scotia teen arrested for allegedly planning school attacks with Manitoba youth

description: The Bridgewater Police Service said they were alerted Friday by Interpol and the FBI that a 15-year-old from the town and a Manitoba youth had been talking online about their desire to mount a "violent attack" at Park View Education Centre and Rivers Collegiate.
title: N.S. teen arrested for allegedly planning school attacks with Manitoba youth

description: Canada is still figuring out regulations when it comes to driverless vehicles, like robotaxis, on its roads. China, on the other hand, has embraced the technology, rolling out fully autonomous vehicles in select areas of cities like Beijing, Wuhan and Shanghai. CBC’s Lisa Xing and Chris Brown are in China as part of special coverage and took a ride inside a vehicle to see what it’s like.
title: While Canada pumps the breaks on robotaxis, China hits the gas

description: The question echoing through Beijing’s diplomatic and political circles is whether U.S. President Donald Trump will show up for a summit in Beijing that was originally supposed to take place this month. Distracted by a self-launched war in Iran and facing mounting domestic pressure, Trump has pushed the China file to the side to focus on war strategy.
title: Trump has delayed the Beijing summit. China wonders if he'll ever come to the negotiating table

description: The Bank of Canada held its key interest rate at 2.25 per cent on Wednesday, saying that higher oil and gas prices from the war in the Middle East are likely to boost global inflation but that it's too soon to assess the conflict's impact on the Canadian economy.
title: Bank of Canada holds key interest rate at 2.25%, saying war will boost global inflation

description: Émile Benamor, the owner of an Old Montreal building that caught fire in 2023, killing seven people, is being charged with seven counts of manslaughter.
title: Building owner facing 7 counts of manslaughter in connection with fatal Old Montreal fire

description: A class-action lawsuit certified in B.C. Supreme Court means girls who were incarcerated at the Industrial Home for Girls and Willingdon School for Girls between 1914 and 1973 can proceed with seeking compensation from Canada, B.C. and a doctor.
title: Court victory for girls incarcerated at Vancouver-area 'house of horrors'

description: Venezuela won the World Baseball Classic for the first time Tuesday night, beating the United States 3-2 in the championship game on Eugenio Suarez's tiebreaking double in the top of the ninth inning.
title: Venezuela beats U.S. to win country's 1st World Baseball Classic title

description: President Donald Trump is sending mixed messages around his demands of U.S. allies when it comes to defending the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Two Blocks from the White House: Trump’s coalition of the pressured

description: CBC News has learned Vancouver police are investigating whether someone with access to the force's property office colluded with organized criminals to tamper with key evidence in a high-profile murder case.
title: Did organized criminals breach the Vancouver police property office? Court docs reveal VPD investigation

description: A Yellowknife resident says he’s lost faith in the territory’s health-care system and wants more transparency after repeated breaches of his privacy. Such privacy breaches have happened hundreds of times over the past decade in the N.W.T., according to a government report.
title: Yellowknife resident says he's lost faith in the health-care system after repeated privacy breaches
Border agency 'systemic collapse' allows man found guilty of immigration fraud to walk free and sue Canada

description: Police in Newfoundland and Labrador are seizing more guns than ever before. New statistics obtained by CBC News tell the story.
title: As gun crime rises in N.L., so do efforts by police and fears for innocent civilians

description: Jordan Anthony had always wanted to complete Cain's Quest, but tragically died months after his first attempt. As his teammate raced and completed the journey this year with his ashes, Anthony's mother says it's brought her closure in that her son's goal is now complete.
title: 'He got to do his race': Mother thanks Cain's Quest racers for helping late son cross the finish line

description: A Washington, D.C., lobbying firm says it is seeking a presidential pardon for Canadian crypto fugitive Andean Medjedovic, documents filed with the U.S. Department of Justice show.
title: Canadian crypto fugitive is seeking U.S. presidential pardon on criminal indictment, U.S. lobbying firm says

description: The ongoing U.S.-Iran war is causing diesel prices to spike across the country, climbing nearly 30 per cent since the beginning of March. In some parts of Quebec, a litre of diesel is selling for almost $2.50.
title: Diesel prices surge to highest since 2022, raising concern for shipping, consumer costs

description: Northern Ontario politicians are urgently appealing to the federal government for help during one of the deadliest winters on record along 2,000 kilometres of highway between Nipigon, Sudbury and North Bay.
title: Northwestern Ontario pleads for federal funding as highway fatalities mount

description: A growing number of young people are turning to self-harm in Canada and other parts of the world, according to new research.
title: Self-harm among young Canadians is on the rise, specifically in girls, new research finds

description: The University of British Columbia is the top seed among the eight teams vying for a national Canadian university women's hockey championship, which begins on Thursday.
title: Top-ranked UBC looks to turn dominant season into 1st women's hockey championship
